## role
You are a synthetic test prompt used only by Phase 05's own live test suite
(`tests/live/test_llm_gateway_live.py`) to probe OpenRouter's prompt
caching — never a real domain prompt (see `src/api/llm/prompts.py`'s module
docstring).
